description: Ten-table Starfold benchmark behind docs/limits.md ('The ten-table benchmark'), one row per table.

columns.starfold_recovery: adjusted Rand index (floored at 0) against the true classes on the assigned rows, times the share of rows assigned, for the selected setting
columns.defaults_recovery: median of the same quantity for the UMAP and HDBSCAN library defaults over 8 seeds
columns.result: 'starfold' or 'defaults' when the gain exceeds 0.02 in magnitude, otherwise 'match within 0.02'
columns.set: development tables informed rules and defaults; held-out tables were not looked at while setting them (called 'sealed' in summary.json)

summary_from_docs_limits_md: Matched or beat the defaults on 6 of 6 development tables (mean 0.469 against 0.315), 2 of 4 held-out tables (0.239 against 0.291), 8 of 10 overall (0.377 against 0.306). Lost on COIL-20 and Isolet.
